Frequently asked questions

Everything You Need to Know

Renim AI is built from the ground up as a unified daily command center. Instead of having your meeting transcripts in one app, your tasks in another, your calendar in a third, and your thoughts in a fourth, Renim AI synchronizes them all together with an AI Copilot that has full context of your entire workday.

No! Renim AI is a standalone, web-based Single Page Application (SPA). It uses the browser’s native Web Audio API and Web Speech API for low-latency live microphone recording and soundwave visualization with zero extra downloads required.

You have full flexibility! You can configure your own AI Gateway endpoint (such as Cloudflare AI Gateway, OpenAI, or compatible proxies) and choose any model directly from the in-app Settings menu.

Yes. All your cloud data is stored in your dedicated database protected by PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS). Only your authenticated user ID can read and write your notes, meetings, and calendar events.

Yes — a free account keeps your notes, meetings and tasks private and synced across your devices. Signing up takes under a minute and no card is required.
